plugin.name: rewrite-maven-plugin
plugin.description: Eliminate technical debt. At build time.

mojo.description:
Generate a report of the available recipes and styles found on the classpath.
Can also be used to display information about a specific recipe. For example: ./mvnw rewrite:discover -Ddetail=true -Drecipe=org.openrewrite.java.format.AutoFormat

parameter.name: additionalPlainTextMasks
parameter.description: Allows to add additional plain text masks without overriding the defaults.

parameter.name: detail
parameter.description: Whether to display recipe details such as displayName, description, and configuration options.

parameter.name: failOnInvalidActiveRecipes
parameter.description: Whether to throw an exception if an activeRecipe fails configuration validation. This may happen if the activeRecipe is improperly configured, or any downstream recipes are improperly configured. For the time, this default is "false" to prevent one improperly recipe from failing the build. In the future, this default may be changed to "true" to be more restrictive.

parameter.name: plainTextMasks
parameter.description: Override default plain text masks. If this is specified, rewrite.additionalPlainTextMasks will have no effect.

parameter.name: recipe
parameter.description: The name of a specific recipe to show details for. For example: ./mvnw rewrite:discover -Ddetail=true -Drecipe=org.openrewrite.java.format.AutoFormat

parameter.name: recursion
parameter.description: The maximum level of recursion to display recipe descriptors under recipeList.

parameter.name: skipMavenParsing
parameter.description: When enabled, skip parsing Maven `pom.xml`s, and any transitive poms, as source files. This can be an efficiency improvement in certain situations.

mojo.description: Generate warnings to the console for any recipe that would make changes, but do not make changes. This variant of rewrite:dryRun will fork the maven life cycle and can be run as a "stand-alone" goal. It will execute the maven build up to the process-test-classes phase.

parameter.name: additionalPlainTextMasks
parameter.description: Allows to add additional plain text masks without overriding the defaults.

parameter.name: failOnDryRunResults
parameter.description: Whether to throw an exception if there are any result changes produced.

parameter.name: failOnInvalidActiveRecipes
parameter.description: Whether to throw an exception if an activeRecipe fails configuration validation. This may happen if the activeRecipe is improperly configured, or any downstream recipes are improperly configured. For the time, this default is "false" to prevent one improperly recipe from failing the build. In the future, this default may be changed to "true" to be more restrictive.

parameter.name: recipeChangeLogLevel

mojo.description: Display help information on rewrite-maven-plugin. Call mvn rewrite:help -Ddetail=true -Dgoal=<goal-name> to display parameter details.

parameter.name: detail
parameter.description: If true, display all settable properties for each goal.

parameter.name: goal
parameter.description: The name of the goal for which to show help. If unspecified, all goals will be displayed.

parameter.name: indentSize
parameter.description: The number of spaces per indentation level, should be positive.

parameter.name: lineLength
parameter.description: The maximum length of a display line, should be positive.
